scope: Three/four-point FRAME fallback using explicit complete XYZWPR values

reference_basis.documented: FRAME uses first-to-second X direction, a third point in the positive XY half-plane, right-handed Z, first or optional fourth origin/configuration, and minimum 10 mm first/second and third-to-line distances
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native POSITION overload/result conversion, pause/error numbers, arithmetic rounding and Euler conventions remain unvalidated

implementation_choices.types: Exactly three or four complete initialized XYZWPR values; fallback preserves internal FRAME routines and ordinary names; no implicit positional conversion
implementation_choices.basis: Normalize first-to-second X; Z is normalized X cross first-to-third; normalize Z cross X for Y and reconstruct normalized X cross Y for Z
implementation_choices.origin_configuration: Independent copy of first location/CONFIG, or fourth when supplied; fourth has no separation requirement and does not affect basis
implementation_choices.geometry: Inclusive 10 mm first/second separation and third distance to their infinite line; Python float hypot norms; require finite differences, cross products and distances
implementation_choices.orientation: Input W/P/R does not determine basis but remains completely validated; output follows frame_transform_semantics.json canonical Z-Y-X and singular-angle policy
implementation_choices.effects: Evaluate and snapshot every complete argument once before later arguments; geometry checked after captures; preserve earlier effects and destination on failure; independent outputs and ordinary FOR/reference/cleanup checks
implementation_choices.reports: FRAME entries in frame_operations with source locations, operand types and one-based origin_argument; current frame_policy

retained_boundaries: No POSITION/XYZWPREXT/JOINTPOS/VECTOR point operands, implicit coercion or unknown input leaves
No controller frame discovery, task pause/error emulation, external axes, kinematics, reachability or robot configuration inference
Strict remains future work; authored fixtures and independent quaternion checks establish offline geometry only
